parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory tree — a sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. Lifting the shared `DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init` initializer out of the sample app and into a common location would couple production `DebugPanel` code to demonstration semantics. The duplication is intentional: the sample app replicates the debug HUD locally so it can be run standalone without depending on the `DebugPanel` package.
